summary: Sega's 1981 third-person arcade racing game, a pioneer of scaling-sprite road visuals, changing scenery, weather, and cockpit cabinet presentation.

entries.title: Turbo

emulation.notes: MAME preserves the arcade software; original cockpit hardware is required for the full cabinet control and gauge experience.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade presentation with modern scaling; physical cockpit features only on original hardware

primary.version: Original Sega arcade release, preferably environmental cockpit cabinet
primary.why: Turbo was built for Sega arcade hardware and manufactured in upright, cabaret, and seated environmental/cockpit cabinets with wheel, gearshift, pedal, LED score panel, and gauges. The arcade cockpit version is the highest-fidelity route; ColecoVision and Intellivision are lower-fidelity home ports.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; use the seated environmental/cockpit cabinet where available for the intended controls and dashboard hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: The advertised Atari 2600 port was never completed; the recovered prototype is not a commercial release row.
